<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates that break a ketone (carbonyl) and form an alkene, with a new C‑C bond formed, which matches a cycloaddition forward reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
